details:
- CVE-2026-25968: stack buffer overflow in MSL image-processing language via
  WriteMSLImage recursion
- CVE-2026-25897: out-of-bounds heap write in SUN decoder on 32-bit systems
  via integer overflow in pixel buffer allocation
- CVE-2025-53014: out-of-bounds read in InterpretImageFilename when processing
  escaped percent characters
- CVE-2025-53101: out-of-bounds read in InterpretImageFilename via missing
  bounds check on format specifier parsing
